# FragView — Perfume Reviews & Discovery
> FragView is a modern fragrance discovery and review platform where users can explore thousands of perfumes, read detailed reviews, discover new scents, and manage a personal fragrance wardrobe.

## What is FragView?
FragView is a community-driven perfume review website. It provides detailed fragrance profiles including scent notes, accords, longevity, sillage, ratings, and user reviews. Users can build a personal wardrobe of fragrances they own, love, or want to try.

## Core Features
- **Perfume Discovery**: Browse and search 10,000+ fragrances from 500+ brands
- **Fragrance Reviews**: Read and write honest community reviews with star ratings
- **Personal Wardrobe**: Save and organize fragrances into personal collections
- **Brand Explorer**: Explore fragrance houses and their complete collections
- **The Drydown**: Editorial fragrance content — articles, stories, and industry news
- **Discover**: Trending, top-rated, and seasonal fragrance recommendations
- **Smart Search**: Filter by brand, gender, accord, rating, longevity, and sillage

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://www.fragview.com): Main hub with featured and trending fragrances
- [All Perfumes](https://www.fragview.com/perfumes): Browse and filter the full fragrance catalog
- [Brands](https://www.fragview.com/brands): Browse all fragrance brands and houses
- [The Drydown](https://www.fragview.com/drydown): Editorial fragrance articles and stories
- [Discover](https://www.fragview.com/discover): Trending and curated fragrance recommendations
- [Search](https://www.fragview.com/search): Advanced fragrance search with filters
- [Contact](https://www.fragview.com/contact): Contact the FragView team

## Data & Content
FragView contains:
- 10,000+ fragrance listings with notes, accords, concentration, gender, and descriptions
- 500+ perfume brands including niche houses and heritage classics
- Community reviews with detailed ratings on longevity, sillage, and scent profile
- Editorial articles on fragrance culture, style, and how to wear scent
- Structured product data with Schema.org markup (Product, AggregateRating)

## About
FragView is a fragrance-focused web application built with Next.js. It is designed to help perfume enthusiasts make informed purchasing decisions without advertising pressure. All content is community-generated or editorially curated.
